source_snapshot.procedure: Labels both steps Correctable but invokes AMD errortype2 at a literal endpoint/root-port pair after AER/severity/SyncFlood setup.
source_snapshot.criteria: Requires uncorrectable PASS and calls the stimulus fatal ECRC.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic logs and correctable-memory wording do not reconcile severity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags the Correctable/fatal contradiction and lacks authoritative errortype2 and fatal recovery semantics.

old_problem: The fatal ECRC title/note conflicts with Correctable step labels, errortype2 is proprietary and unproven, and the fatal containment/reset/boot branch has no authoritative oracle or safe recovery contract.
disposition_reason: Topology and timeout can be parameterized, but they cannot resolve the core stimulus identity. Standard PCIe AER defines ECRC reporting, not what this AMD tool's errortype2 emits or whether the project's AER/DPC/SyncFlood policy must reset the host. ED-03/12/15/16 prohibit guessing a fatal command, PASS branch or recovery; Pending and BLOCKED therefore remain until vendor/project authority reconciles the contradiction.
decision_basis: Read exact Reliability row59, both AI reviews, historical record2460, non-fatal companions and next OCP fatal row60.
Preserved PCIe slot 1~N, endpoint/upstream source positions, ECRC and fatal containment/reset coverage.
Separated parameterizable topology from non-parameterizable errortype2 and fatal-outcome semantics.
Required durable OOB evidence because fatal reset may erase OS logs.
No BIOS/HDT/AER change, fatal injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: For every approved PCIe slot, verify an authoritative fatal-ECRC stimulus at endpoint and upstream port produces the project-approved fatal containment/reset path and complete boot, device and link recovery.
required_package: Vendor proof of errortype2 meaning and correction of the Correctable/fatal labels
Deterministic fatal containment/reset and durable-evidence matrix
OOB boot/reimage, device/link recovery and exact restoration runbook
test_case.test_command: Do not execute errortype2. After the command conflict is formally resolved, capture durable pre-state/OOB console, target one topology-verified source, perform exactly one authorized fatal ECRC stimulus, record AER source and the approved containment/reset/boot branch, then restore and verify the platform before any separate target.
test_case.expected_result: The authoritative stimulus reports fatal ECRC at the intended source and follows exactly the signed containment or reset branch; durable BMC/UEFI/OOB evidence survives the event; the OS, driver, device and link recover within approved deadlines and all modified state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is possible until errortype2, severity and the expected fatal branch are authoritative. A tool PASS, generic OS log, Correctable event, wrong source, missing durable record, unexpected/no reset, boot failure or unrecovered device cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC console and known-good boot/reimage path.
No command execution while Correctable versus fatal semantics conflict.
One verified non-critical target once; abort on wrong source, unexpected severity, boot loop or missing durable evidence.
No automatic retry or reset; preserve crash evidence before recovery.
expected_evidence: Fatal injection transcript and ECRC AER source/severity
test_case.recovery: Must be supplied and approved for both containment-without-reset and fatal-reset branches, including boot-loop escape, reimage and exact AER/BIOS/HDT restoration; execution remains blocked until proven.

source_conflict.reason: Fatal ECRC intent, Correctable labels and proprietary errortype2 remain irreconcilable without vendor authority.

blocked.reason: Executing an unverified fatal stimulus without deterministic reset/boot recovery is unsafe.
